universal_advance_gate.description: Applies to every code phase across all project types before the phase is marked complete.
universal_advance_gate.exempt_reason: Phase 0 and D produce documents only. Phase 7 captures learnings. Phases 8, 11-16 are human-owned QA, infra, legal, and launch steps with no new code deliverables.
universal_advance_gate.criterion: Run /phase-audit. Address critical findings (dead code, broken conventions) before advancing. Defer acceptable shortcuts with a ponytail: comment. Attach the score line to the phase sign-off.

description: Custom project — all tools available, no type-specific guidance
roadmap:
0. Foundation: event-storming → ubiquitous-language (even for custom projects — name the domain concepts before building)
1. Define what you’re building
2. Set up the project structure
3. Build iteratively with Claude Code
4. Test as you go with /test
5. Ingest relevant docs into the knowledgebase as needed
6. Ship when ready
